goals.description: Fired once the account exists and the person is signed in, right after identify().
Fired when the first payment succeeds and the plan becomes active.
Fired when a writer shares a document by link, email or export.

sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1786050411451
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826411451
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'signup_completed', 'subscription_started', 'document_shared')
)
SELECT event AS ev_name, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS visitors FROM ev WHERE event IN ('signup_completed', 'subscription_started', 'document_shared') GROUP BY event
UNION ALL
SELECT '$visitors' AS ev_name, 0 AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS visitors FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview'
